Select chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules in document CHEMBL2417551. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2417551'. Return distinct rows. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
